findings.finding: The Statement caption leaves the known court number and known court type blank in both fixtures. The source directs the participant to copy the court caption; these are not judge-only fields. Canonical holds County Court at Law No. 2 and boundary holds County Criminal Court at Law No. 15, visibly printed on packet page 4. Packet page 11 has no number and none of the five court-type choices selected.
findings.repair: Map the held court number and select the source-authored County Court at Law option from the held court identity. Keep the source Cause Number blank because its printed instruction assigns it to the clerk; do not infer a county that the fixture does not explicitly hold.

findings.finding: All three declaration birth-date boxes on packet page 21 are blank although page 12 prints the complete held DOB. The map incorrectly treats Day / Día and Month / Mes as signature/date protected; Year / Año is generic REQUIRED_BEFORE_FILING. The participant instructions do not identify a manual birth-date completion task, omit Day / Día and Month / Mes, and describe Year / Año only with a generic financial/household completion sentence.
findings.repair: Correct the birth-date classification and completion treatment without marking the notary widget. Prefer per-widget source-faithful DOB output on source page 11; if a governed manual-completion exception is retained for the shared field, record that actual exception and give a precise declaration-DOB task. Do not label the participant DOB a signature date, and do not globally fill Month / Mes because its second widget belongs to the notary. This finding is specific to the automatic family and does not reopen the other Texas families.

findings.finding: Known address data is withheld. The Statement mailing-address field on packet page 12 is blank in both fixtures although the OCA letter page 6 contains the held mailing address. The boundary declaration page 21 prints only 901 West Twenty-Third Street, Apartment 14 and omits the supplied El Paso, Texas 79901, despite the printed field requiring Street, city, zip, country.
